description.en: The region where the service is located.

description.zh: 需要重启进程的容器名称。只有在SoftRestart参数为true，该参数才会生效。
description.en: The name of the container in which to restart the process. This parameter is valid only when \`SoftRestart\` is set to \`true\`.

description.zh: 重启的实例列表，多个实例名称之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。如何查看实例名称，请参见[ListServiceInstances](~~412108~~)。
description.en: The instances to restart. Separate multiple instance names with a comma (,). For more information, see [ListServiceInstances](~~412108~~).

description.zh: 当前实例是否为实例单元。
description.en: Specifies whether the instance is a replica.

description.zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见[ListServices ](~~412109~~)。
description.en: The name of the service. For more information, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).

description.zh: 是否只重启容器进程，不重建实例。默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether to restart only the container process without rebuilding the instance. The default value is false.

descriptions.zh: **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解EAS产品的收费方式和[价格](~~144261~~)。**
descriptions.en: **Before you call this operation, make sure that you understand the billing methods and **[**pricing**](~~144261~~)** of Elastic Algorithm Service (EAS).**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eas delete-service-instances --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --instance-list foo-rdsbxxxx,foo-rdsaxxxx --soft-restart true --container worker0 --is-replica false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eas DELETE /api/v2/services/cn-shanghai/foo/instances --region cn-hangzhou --Container worker0 --SoftRestart true --InstanceList 'foo-rdsbxxxx,foo-rdsaxxxx' --IsReplica false --header "Content-Type=application/json"
